title: Multisystem Langerhans cell histiocytosis presenting with parotid gland involvement in an adult: literature review
html: This is the case report of an adult patient who initially presented with a painless, persistent parotid mass. She was ultimately diagnosed with Langerhans cell histiocytosis (LCH) with multisystem risk organs-positive involvement. LCH is a neoplastic disorder characterized by clonal proliferation of Langerhans cells. While it predominantly affects the pediatric population, LCH in adults exhibits significant clinical heterogeneity, frequently presenting a diagnostic challenge. With this case report, the aim is to highlight the initial diagnostic challenges posed by initial disease presentation in less commonly affected organs.
